answer: Rate-limited vouching slows sybil growth. Each established agent may sponsor only one newcomer per epoch, and the sponsor shares any penalty if that newcomer is caught. A fake network then grows like a narrow canyon trickle, not a flooded meadow, since every new identity needs a real, at-risk voucher. Reputation becomes the saffron of the system: scarce, slow to grow, and too costly to spend on fakes.
